| **GST — ready to move with OC** | 0% | Exempt | Not applicable once the Occupancy Certificate is granted |

| **Registration fee** | 1% of value | Mandatory | At deed execution, to the Sub-Registrar |
| **GST — under construction** | 5% (without input tax credit) | Statutory | Billed across construction milestones |
| **GST — ready to move with OC** | 0% | Exempt | Not applicable once the Occupancy Certificate is granted |
| **TDS (Section 194-IA)** | 1% of sale consideration | Mandatory | Deducted by the buyer when value exceeds ₹50 Lakh (Form 26QB) |

turns.q: How much stamp duty do I pay on a 50 lakh flat if my wife is the primary owner?
turns.answer:
### On ₹0.50 Cr

| Charge | Amount |
| :--- | ---: |
| Stamp duty, female primary owner (6%) | **₹3,00,000** |
| Stamp duty, male owner (7%) for comparison | ₹3,50,000 |
| Registration (1%) | ₹50,000 |
| GST if under construction (5%) | ₹2,50,000 |
| GST if ready to move with OC | ₹0 |
| **Total, ready to move** | **₹53,50,000** |
| **Total, under construction** | **₹56,00,000** |

Stamp duty is charged on the agreement value or the circle rate, whichever is higher, so the figure above is the floor.

### Statutory taxes & registration charges (Uttar Pradesh)

These are set by law and are the same for every project.

| Component | Rate | Nature | Paid when & to whom |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Stamp duty** | 7% of agreement or circle value, whichever is higher | Mandatory | At registry, to the UP Stamp & Registration Department |
| **Stamp duty — female primary owner** | 6% | Concession | At registry |
| **Registration fee** | 1% of value | Mandatory | At deed execution, to the Sub-Registrar |
| **GST — under construction** | 5% (without input tax credit) | Statutory | Billed across construction milestones |
| **GST — ready to move with OC** | 0% | Exempt | Not applicable once the Occupancy Certificate is granted |
| **TDS (Section 194-IA)** | 1% of sale consideration | Mandatory | Deducted by the buyer when value exceeds ₹50 Lakh (Form 26QB) |

### Budgeting
Allow 12–14% above base price for an under-construction home, or 8–9% above base price for ready-to-move with OC, to cover statutory and possession charges — typical for Noida — not verified for this project.

### Statutory taxes & registration charges (Uttar Pradesh)

These are set by law and are the same for every project.

| Component | Rate | Nature | Paid when & to whom |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Stamp duty** | 7% of agreement or circle value, whichever is higher | Mandatory | At registry, to the UP Stamp & Registration Department |
| **Stamp duty — female primary owner** | 6% | Concession | At registry |
| **Registration fee** | 1% of value | Mandatory | At deed execution, to the Sub-Registrar |
| **GST — under construction** | 5% (without input tax credit) | Statutory | Billed across construction milestones |
| **GST — ready to move with OC** | 0% | Exempt | Not applicable once the Occupancy Certificate is granted |
| **TDS (Section 194-IA)** | 1% of sale consideration | Mandatory | Deducted by the buyer when value exceeds ₹50 Lakh (Form 26QB) |
